title: Pipes Carry Text
story: In the Control Room, every tool does one small thing, and pipes connect them. Chilaka's job: plumb them together.
goal: Learn the idea of a pipe, then check yourself.

tests.label: Finish every try-it and quick check

hints: Read each block, then do the TRY IT and QUICK CHECK parts.
Every interactive block must be done to finish the lesson.
Take your time. Nothing here is timed.
socratic: Compare your result with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: what is the most useful thing you learned here?

blocks.text:
A pipe `|` feeds the output of one command into the next. `grep ERROR` keeps lines with ERROR. `sort` orders lines. `uniq -c` counts neighbours that repeat. `head -n 3` keeps the first three.

Because `uniq` only compares neighbours, you almost always `sort` first.

blocks.title: How often does each fruit appear?

options: uniq only merges lines that sit next to each other
blocks.why: Equal lines must be neighbours for uniq to notice them.

blocks.q: Which part keeps only lines that contain a word?
